texts: The ledgers record three near-miss winters.
No wraith emerged in the near-miss winters.

fields.sentence: The ledgers record three near-miss winters.

q1_issues.issue: The per-member rule asserts that every individual ledger records the same three near-miss winters (the shared `sk_group_2` constant in the conclusion's `Theme`), which relocates the count "three" from a total across the ledgers to three per ledger; by the instruction set's own distributive/collective test ("each member acts separately" vs "the group as one unit") this aggregate inventory predication is the group-as-unit case and should stay group-only.

review.notes: The rest is right: definite plural subject to a group witness, inanimate stative-transitive subject to `Agent` (the "manifest lists two pallets" case), "record" as an evaluate/record verb to `Theme`, counted plural object to group + `Cardinality 3`, bare present with no status atom, and the fused compound riding the group's kind slot with its head genus only (noun modifier correctly not exposed).

issues.reason: The rule's conclusion carries the shared constant sk_group_2, which bears (Cardinality sk_group_2 3), so it asserts that EACH ledger records all three near-miss winters - more than the text states, and the same over-assertion the instruction set blocks elsewhere for aggregate readings over a plural subject ("a measure on a PLURAL subject is the group AGGREGATE, like Cardinality - it does NOT distribute to each member").

new_gaps: No stated test decides whether a TRANSITIVE predicate whose OBJECT carries an aggregate count distributes to the plural subject's members: the distributive/collective lists (bark, pass, laugh, arrive vs gather, meet, assemble, collide) are all intransitive-shaped, and the only aggregate precedent is the Measure-on-a-plural-subject note under *Measures & units*.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form drops ledgers_rule entirely and keeps the group-level predication alone - (GroupOf sk_group_1 ledger), (GroupOf sk_group_2 near_miss_winter), (Cardinality sk_group_2 3), (Member sk_record_1 record), (Agent sk_record_1 sk_group_1), (Theme sk_record_1 sk_group_2), plus the compound genus - since an aggregate inventory predication is the group-as-unit case and stays group-only.
adjudication.notes: Everything else is doctrinal: definite plural to a group witness, the stative-transitive subject staying Agent, record as an evaluate/record verb taking Theme, the counted object as group + Cardinality, and the fused compound's head genus with its noun modifier correctly unexposed.

fields.sentence: No wraith emerged in the near-miss winters.

q1_issues.issue: The clause is past tense ('emerged') but the distributed conclusion bundle carries no (Past ...) atom, so the strength-0 rule denies an unmarked/generic emergence rather than the past one (the universal pattern 'All the students passed' puts (Past (sk_pass $x)) inside the conclusion).

q2_gaps: temporal-frame PP whose object is a definite plural period NP ('in the near-miss winters'): Time's fillers are specified as structured calendar terms or deictic/named constants, and During is restricted to the surface words during/while/throughout, so surface 'in' plus a group-of-periods witness has no specified head
review.notes: The strength-0 distributing rule plus the mandatory 'no' QuantifierPhrase companion, the definite-plural group witness, and the near_miss_winter genus with the noun modifier left unexposed are all correct. Only the dropped past tense is at issue.

issues.reason: 'emerged' is a finite past clause, and the distribution pattern puts tense inside the consequent ('All the students passed' emits `(Past (sk_pass $x))` in the conclusion bundle); without it the strength-0 rule denies an unmarked event, which Status predicates defines as 'generic / habitual / dispositional — not a specific occurrence', a different claim from the one the sentence makes.

gaps_confirmed: No licensed `Time` filler for a frame PP whose object is a definite plural period NP ('in the near-miss winters'): `Time` takes structured calendar terms or deictic/named constants, and `During` renders only during/while/throughout, so a group witness in the Time slot is improvised.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form adds `(Past (sk_emerge $x))` as a conjunct of the rule's consequent, inside the strength-0.0 `(Implication ...)`.
adjudication.notes: The routing is otherwise right — 'no' is an explicit quantifier, so the generic denial takes the distributing rule at strength 0.0 with its mandatory "no" QuantifierPhrase companion, and the definite plural takes a group witness. `(Time (sk_emerge $x) sk_winters_1)` is acceptable improvisation in the gap above: the atom is true of the content and the group is asserted at top level.

review.notes: The bare-plural generic subject correctly takes the Skolem-function event rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion, and the definite plural object correctly takes a GroupOf witness (which also correctly blocks the bare-kinds-on-both-sides relational-generic route); the fused classifier keeps its head genus with the noun modifier unexposed.
